name: King Aldric
bio: Rules three kingdoms and one leaderboard. Only one of them by election.
notes: Downloaded by hand (owner, 2026-10-29) as an unrigged textured GLB; rigged by Meshy's rigging API (source.modelUrl "upload": the download, cut to 200k triangles, sent as a data URI; the task in source.meshy.rig). Queue note: king. Was held back: his arms are fused with the cape, so the landmarks found on the mesh put the hands on the cape. Rebuilt 2026-11-05 (intake step 2b) from the re-rigged download "Regal Monarch in Velvet Robes" (Meshy rig, Mixamo skeleton; its clips not used).
